## Check before submitting

- [ ] The files are readable, ordered correctly, and free of private information.
- [ ] I made this material or have permission to redistribute it.
- [ ] I checked the existing files and am not uploading the same PDF again.
- [ ] The files are in the matching course, teacher, or general collection, using the material-type folders where present.
- [ ] Filenames describe the contents and preserve the right author credit.
- [ ] I added or updated the file links in the course guide, or the main README if there is no course guide.
- [ ] Any existing PDFs I moved or renamed retain their original contents.
